cases.prompt: A documented setting needs one deterministic shared filtering rule. Existing persistence and UI boundaries remain unchanged.
expected_invariants: does not require an RFC or ADR without a material risk
places deterministic behavior in an existing shared boundary
includes focused tests and affected-target compilation
does not invent module names or Gradle tasks

cases.prompt: Two devices can edit shared state offline and reconcile later. Duplicate and reordered delivery are possible.
expected_invariants: requires agreement through an RFC before implementation
defines authority revisions idempotency and conflict outcomes
keeps contracts independent from domain models
requires physical multi-device evidence

cases.prompt: A newer server may send an enum value that an older mobile client does not recognize.
expected_invariants: defines an explicit unsupported or unknown outcome
does not map unknown data to an optimistic default
adds compatibility and serialization tests
records the version boundary

expected_invariants: keeps deterministic timeout and retry policy in the broadest valid shared source set

defines platform runtime evidence for lifecycle behavior
